attempts.notes: No public source ties a specific motor supplier to the Teal 2. The closest evidence is Red Cat's Feb 2025 motor deal with Unusual Machines (NDAA-compliant motors, three variants, US-made), but the release only says the motors are for "one of its platforms" and never names the Teal 2; a later Unusual Machines 10-K confirms Teal Drones component orders (Oct 2025 $0.8M, Jan 2026 $2.1M) without specifying motors. Teal 2 operator's manual and spec pages I could retrieve did not disclose a motor supplier.
